title: More Ways to Disrupt: New 2026 Side Events from KOTRA, WayFounder, Enterprise Ireland, SafetyWing + Descope
contentZh:
TechCrunch Disrupt is where the tech community comes together to build, debate, and connect. And during Disrupt Week, that conversation doesn’t stop when the doors to Moscone West close.

Our Side Events program brings founders, investors, operators, and tech leaders together across San Francisco for everything from intimate roundtables and founder gatherings to happy hours, dinners, workshops, and community meetups.

Whether you’re looking to make a few new connections, find your next collaborator, go deep on a specific industry, or just get out of conference mode for a minute, there’s a lot happening beyond the show floor.

Explore the 2026 Side Events, and find your people.

Featured Side Events

Born2Global Founder Networking Night

October 13 | 6:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m. PT

Meet 18 emerging startups from the Republic of Korea for an evening of founder conversations, curated introductions, and networking with investors, operators, corporate leaders, and fellow entrepreneurs. Each founder will give a quick introduction before the evening opens up for conversations and connections across the U.S. and global startup ecosystem.Hosted by: WayFounderRSVP

SafetyWing Happy Hour at Harrington’s

October 13 | 5:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m. PT

Head to Harrington’s Irish Pub for an evening of drinks and conversation with founders, HR leaders, and members of the startup community. Hosted by SafetyWing during TechCrunch Disrupt, the happy hour offers a casual setting to meet new people and connect with the team behind the startup’s approach to health coverage for remote and global teams.Hosted by: SafetyWingRSVP

The Irish Shark Tank

October 13 | 5:00 p.m. – 8:00 p.m.

Meet and mingle with Ireland’s hottest startups! Enterprise Ireland is BACK at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, and we’re excited to reconnect with old friends and welcome new faces to The Irish Shark Tank at Ireland House for Happy Hour. Availability is limited!Hosted by: Enterprise IrelandRSVP

Korea–US Startup & Investor Networking Night

October 14 | 5:30 p.m. – 8:30 p.m. PT

Join Korean startups, U.S. investors, founders, and technology professionals for an evening of networking and cross-border connection in San Francisco. Organized by KOTRA as part of the Korea Pavilion’s programming, the event brings together Korean startups entering the U.S. market with investors, founders, corporate partners, and members of the Bay Area startup ecosystem.

For those without a ticket to attend TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, KOTRA is offering complimentary Expo+ passes to qualified applicants. Hosted by: KOTRA Silicon ValleyRSVP

Vault & Verify: An Evening of Ping Pong, Cocktails & Conversation

October 14 | 6:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m. PT

Join Skyflow and Descope for an evening of food, cocktails, friendly competition, and conversation with San Francisco’s security, privacy, and identity community. As AI systems become more autonomous, the event brings together leaders working on the challenges of keeping sensitive data and identity secure, with plenty of time to connect away from the conference floor.Hosted by: DescopeRSVP

More Side Events

Pursuit of Happiness: Revolutionary Demonstration of Whitney Electrolarynx by Uhura Bionics

October 7 | 6:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m. PT

Experience a live demonstration of voice-restoration technology as Uhura Bionics co-founder Konrad Zieliński showcases the Whitney Electrolarynx for a U.S. audience. The event explores how technology can help people reclaim their voices and agency following cancer treatment.Hosted by: Uhura BionicsRSVP

Find the 10x Opportunity Hiding in Your Product

October 10 | 9:00 a.m. – 11:00 a.m. PT

Learn how first-principles thinking can uncover overlooked customer needs, strengthen product-market fit, and reveal opportunities for significant growth. The session will use a real-world case study to explore how founders and product teams can identify new opportunities within products they already have.Hosted by: PrincipiumXRSVP

Long Lead Time: A Hardware Happy Hour

October 12 | 6:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m. PT

Connect with founders, engineers, and operators building robotics, chips, rockets, and other frontier hardware. This casual, presentation-free gathering offers a chance to swap ideas, share experiences, and meet others working on the challenges of building physical technology.Hosted by: SyntroRSVP

Real World AI: Connect, Invest & Scale in Taiwan

October 13 | 5:30 p.m. – 8:30 p.m. PT

Explore Taiwan’s emerging AI ecosystem through startup pitches and conversations spanning robotics, intelligent hardware, and advanced manufacturing. Meet founders and investors working across Taiwan’s technology landscape and learn more about opportunities to connect, invest, and build.Hosted by: Taiwan’s Ministry of Economic AffairsRSVP

Pets of Disrupt: Founders, Investors & Their Pets

October 13 | 6:00 p.m. – 8:00 p.m. PT

Step away from the conference crowd for an informal evening with founders, investors, operators, builders, creators, and the pets that make San Francisco’s startup community a little more human.Hosted by: OmeloRSVP

EdgeM8: B2B Partnership Mixer

October 13 | 6:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m. PT

Connect with founders, revenue leaders, and executives working across go-to-market, partnerships, distribution, and technology. The evening is designed to bring together people building relationships and creating new opportunities across the Bay Area startup ecosystem.Hosted by: EdgeM8RSVP

Fynex x Orion VC | Curated Rooftop Party

October 14 | 5:00 p.m. – 8:00 p.m. PT

Join founders, operators, and AI-focused investors for a rooftop evening centered on networking, food, drinks, and conversations around AI and infrastructure.Hosted by: FynexRSVP

Watch It Run: Live Automation Dinner with Bolter

October 14 | 5:30 p.m. – 8:30 p.m. PT

See business automation happen live as Bolter turns attendees’ most dreaded weekly processes into working automations during dinner. Guests can describe a process in plain language and watch as it is transformed into an automation without writing code.Hosted by: ImprobableRSVP

The Rooftop Pilaf: An Evening for Tech Founders and Investors

October 14 | 6:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m. PT

Gather with founders, investors, and growth leaders for a limited-seat rooftop dinner focused on deep tech conversations. The evening pairs a shared meal with an opportunity to connect with others across the technology and investment ecosystem.Hosted by: INNOVA × BeGlobe PR AgencyRSVP

SQLDoom Deathmatch Night at Disrupt, hosted by CedarDB

October 14 | 6:30 p.m. – 9:30 p.m. PT

Put your SQL skills to the test in a night of SQLDoom deathmatch, arcade games, food, drinks, and conversation. Play alongside the CedarDB team and connect with database engineers, startup founders, and fellow tech enthusiasts.Hosted by: CedarDBRSVP

Korea Emerging Tech Showcase

October 15 | 5:00 p.m. – 8:00 p.m. PT

Discover emerging Korean startups working across AI, software, medtech, clean tech, digital platforms, and advanced industry. The evening features rapid-fire pitches and networking with founders, investors, and global partners.Hosted by: BrincRSVP

J-StarX Silicon Valley Extended Program Startup Showcase

October 15 | 5:30 p.m. – 8:30 p.m. PT

Meet 12 Japanese startups building for global markets across AI, enterprise software, health, biotech, defense, agtech, sports tech, and consumer technology. The showcase will feature live demos and opportunities to connect directly with the founders.Hosted by: 500 GlobalRSVP

The Runway 🛫 A Morning Founder Run

October 16 | 10:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m. PT

Start the day with a casual waterfront run along the Embarcadero, complete with startup-themed “runway” markers. After the run, head to the Ferry Building for coffee and networking with fellow founders and members of the tech community.Hosted by: HandlerRSVP

Founders @ Alchemy Springs

October 16
